newsitem.title: MEXICO: Ahmsa first-half exports little changed.
newsitem.headline: Ahmsa first-half exports little changed.

text.p: Mexican steel producer Altos Hornos de Mexico SA de CV said on Friday its total steel exports during the first half of the year dipped to 491,000 tonnes from 495,000 tonnes during the same period of 1995.
It said co-exports -- raw materials from Ahmsa is processed by another company for export -- rose to 137,400 tonnes from 34,600 tonnes.
Domestic demand for finished steel products rose 24 percent during the first half, the company said, without providing figures for the 1996 and 1995 periods.
